producao.theClockMeasuresTheLogged: The clock measures the logged time of tasks of this type.

produtos.duplicatedEditTheCopyFrom: {name} duplicated. Edit the copy from here.

produtos.measurementsAndWeightReadBy: Measurements and weight read by the build-up formulas, yield and the cutting plan.
produtos.asListedInTheCatalog: As listed in the catalog: in 50 × 30, X is 50 and Y is 30. Which side goes into the calculation is up to whoever writes the formula.
produtos.whenOffYieldChargesOnly: When off, yield charges only the fraction used, as with ACM. The product step can override this.
produtos.brandsAndColorsSeparatedBy: Brands and colors separated by commas. The system creates one combination for each brand × color, with the same cost, and a sale will then require choosing the variant.
produtos.combinationsWillBeCreatedBrands: {combinations} combinations will be created ({valor} brands × {valor2} colors).
produtos.costAndPriceOfEach: Cost and price of each combination are set at the R$ in the list.
produtos.brandAndColorAreAdded: Brand and color are added after saving, as variants, when editing the material. Different thicknesses and sizes are different materials.
produtos.costAndSellingPriceOf: Cost and selling price of each material variant.
produtos.costIsChangedRightIn: Cost is changed right in the table. The selling price comes from Pricing, through the R$ on each row. To add brands and colors, edit the material.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission3: You don't have permission to view materials.
produtos.materialRecordsArePartOf: Material records are part of the PRO plan. Materials make up the products your company already sells, with no re-entry.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission4: You don't have permission to view product settings.
produtos.theBuildUpRowsAre: The build-up rows are already saved. Only what was changed in the Process card hasn't been saved yet.
produtos.theSameFieldsAsThe2: The same fields as the process record. What the step uses is in the Build-up.
produtos.whenItComesAfterAnother: When it comes after another step
produtos.whatToAskTheCustomer: What to ask the customer, what to check before closing
produtos.theValuesTheSalespersonEnters: The values the salesperson enters and that this process's rows read. A product that includes the process gets these fields, once each.
produtos.setupIsAppliedOncePer: Setup is applied once per order, at the department's hourly cost.
produtos.changesMadeHereAreSaved: Changes made here are saved with the Save button in the footer.
produtos.checkTheUsageForA: Check the usage for a given size. Nothing is saved.
produtos.appliesTheStepSRules: Applies the step's rules: follow the base quantity, use its size and how many fit in it.
produtos.aDepartmentSStepThe: A department's step: the machine, material and labor it uses, each with its own calculation type. A product that includes the process follows this setup.
produtos.afterAnotherStepInheritsThe: After another step, inherits the base size
produtos.afterAnotherStepAsksFor: After another step, asks for its own size
produtos.thisProcessHasNoResources: This process has no resources yet. Add below the machine, material and labor the {valor} department uses, each with its own calculation type.
produtos.whenNoReadyMadeCalculation: When no ready-made calculation type fits, write the formula: it reads the sizes, the quantity and the quote fields of this process, and will show up in the rows' calculation types. A product that includes the process gets the formula along with it.
produtos.productsFollowThisProcessChanging: Products follow this process: changing the setup here changes all of them. Anything a product adjusted just for itself stays as it is, and quotes already made don't change.
produtos.noProductUsesThisProcess: No product uses this process yet.
produtos.whenBuildingAProductNext: When building a product, "+ next step" shows what's checked here first; the rest is under "see all". Checking on one side shows up on the other. With nothing checked, finishings from the same department apply.
produtos.theProcessCardHasnT: The Process card hasn't been saved yet. The rows are already saved.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission5: You don't have permission to view processes.
produtos.confirmationToDeactivateOrReactivate2: Confirmation to deactivate or reactivate the process.
produtos.itShowsUpAgainTo2: It shows up again to pick in build-ups and in quotes. Steps that use it lose the inactive process flag.
produtos.noProductUsesThisProcess2: No product uses this process. It will no longer show up to pick in build-ups and in quotes.
produtos.theStepStaysInThe: . The step stays in the products, flagged "inactive process"; the process just stops being offered in new build-ups and in quotes. Quotes already made don't change.
produtos.whenStartingAProductThe: When starting a product, the process always asks for its own size and quantity. Resources, time and sales rules go in the Build-up tab, after saving; the steps that usually come before and after go in the Usage tab.
produtos.resourcesAndTimeComeAfter: Resources and time come after saving
produtos.fillInTheProcessTab: Fill in the Process tab and save. The process reopens on this tab so you can build the rows: machine, material, labor and time.
produtos.hereAreTheProductsThat: Here are the products that use the process and the steps that usually come before and after it.
produtos.aProcessIsADepartment: A process is a department step that repeats across several products: printing, hem, grommets.
produtos.theProductFollowsTheProcess: · the product follows the process and can adjust it just for itself
produtos.processesArePartOfThe: Processes are part of the PRO plan. Each process is a production step in a department, with machine, material, labor and outsourced work.

vendas.skipTheQuoteSetupAnd: Skip the quote setup and go straight to picking the item.
vendas.setTheDefaultMarkupApplied: Set the default markup applied to the cost of outsourced work added on the spot.
vendas.manageTheSourcesYourCustomers: Manage the sources your customers come from.
vendas.manageSalespeopleTheirCommissionsAnd: Manage salespeople, their commissions and permissions.
vendas.setReasonsToTrackRejections: Set reasons to track rejections and cancellations.
vendas.rejectionAndCancellationReasonSettings: Rejection and cancellation reason settings aren't included in your current plan. Upgrade to customize the reasons for your quotes and work orders.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view rejection and cancellation reasons.
vendas.thisSourceWillNoLonger: This source will no longer appear in your company's options. You can restore it from settings.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission2: You don't have permission to view sales settings.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission3: You don't have permission to view salesperson roles.
vendas.billOnOrderWhenThe: Bill on order (when the sale is approved)
vendas.billAtThePointOf: Bill at the point of sale
vendas.selectTheRolesThatCan: Select the roles that can use this series. If none is selected, all salespeople will have access.
vendas.theQuoteNumberMustBe: The quote number must be zero or greater
vendas.proposalValidityCanBeAt: Proposal validity can be at most 999 days
vendas.deliveryTimeCanBeAt: Delivery time can be at most 999 days
vendas.eraseAllQuotesWorkOrders: Erase all quotes, work orders and transactions.
vendas.allDataFromTheSales: All data from the sales series was erased
vendas.allQuotesWorkOrdersAnd: All quotes, work orders and financial transactions will be erased.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission4: You don't have permission to view sales series.
vendas.quoteStatusSettingsArenT: Quote status settings aren't included in your current plan. Upgrade to customize your quote statuses.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission5: You don't have permission to view quote statuses.
vendas.inTheQuoteTheSalesperson: In the quote, the salesperson enters the supplier's cost and the system suggests the selling price: cost ÷ (1 − markup). The percentage appears next to the price and the salesperson can change the value on the spot. Outsourced work gets no allocation or overhead cost: the price is just the cost plus this margin.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission6: You don't have permission to configure one-off outsourced work.
vendas.addingOutsourcedWorkInsideA: Adding outsourced work inside a quote item is part of the LITE plan.
vendas.whenOnItShowsUp: When on, it shows up in the Sales menu. The salesperson skips the quote setup and goes straight to picking the item, which is where the sale happens: a copy, a couple of prints, counter service.
vendas.whatTheSystemFillsIn: What the system fills in on its own
vendas.theseAreTheFieldsOf: These are the fields of the new quote dialog. Set once here, they're no longer asked on every sale.
vendas.everyQuickSaleIsAssigned: Every quick sale is assigned to this customer. It's usually your own company or a generic end customer, like "Walk-in customer": create it once in Records and pick it here. If the sale needs an invoice or installments, the salesperson changes the customer inside the quote, and pre-registration is still available there.
vendas.leaveEmptyToLetThe: Leave empty to let the items describe the sale
vendas.alwaysTheUserCurrentlyUsing: Always the user currently using the system
vendas.aQuickSaleIsStill: A quick sale is still a regular quote, marked as quick: it follows the same path to approval, work order and finance.
vendas.aCounterSaleIsnT: A counter sale isn't left open: it's either charged on the spot or sent to the point of sale to be closed with the rest of the day's activity.
vendas.chargeOnTheSpotCash: Charge on the spot, cash payment only
vendas.theSaleClosesAtThe: The sale closes at the counter, with no installments and no future charges.
vendas.theSaleGoesToThe: The sale goes to the point of sale, where payment is collected along with the day's cash register.
vendas.withNoMethodSelectedA: With no method selected, a quick sale can't be closed.
vendas.whenTheCustomerLeavesThe: When the customer leaves the job to pick up later, the register only releases it once the minimum deposit is paid. The rest is collected on pickup. Anyone with permission can waive the deposit case by case.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission7: You don't have permission to configure quick sale.
vendas.counterSalesWithNoSetup: Counter sales, with no setup and no questions, are part of the LITE plan.
